newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 6.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Twelve county-level officials detained in corruption investigation.
Bill Clinton should be re-elected U.S. president barring surprises.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Police detain son of Hsinchu county council speaker for allegedly selling amphetamines.
U.S. Republican Party should retain control of Senate.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Parliament to examine budget for state-run Chinese Petroleum Corp on November 13.
Communications ministry suggests ships should carry "neutral flags" when sailing between Hong Kong and Taiwan after Hong Kong's return to Chinese rule in mid-1997.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Communist China announces guidelines for direct shipping links with Taiwan.
Central bank governor Sheu Yuan-dong says interest rates should not be lowered.
